entities.name: ThiI Q72HP1
observations: The 406-aa query is an exact sequence match to reviewed Thermus thermophilus ThiI (UniProt Q72HP1).
ThiI transfers sulfur to tRNA uridine to form 4-thiouridine at position 8; it also sulfurates ThiS for thiazole/thiamine biosynthesis.
Pfam hits: ThiI_fer (10–75), THUMP (84–158), ThiI (172–364); these support sulfurtransferase/tRNA-related annotation.

entities.name: Thiamine biosynthesis
observations: ThiI-mediated ThiS thiocarboxylation contributes to thiazole formation in thiamine diphosphate biosynthesis.

entities.name: ThiI size and pI
observations: For the unmodified 406-aa query, calculated molecular mass is 44.87 kDa and theoretical pI is 9.277.
